comparison.objective: Use a bamboo mat to roll maki, orient its seam, then reopen the mat; candidate commissions an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated deformation and rolling of food and mat versus rigid hex-key insertion, collar tuning, locking, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Completed roll seam-side down with mat open and released versus two safe dynamic stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Deformable rolling and rigid damper commissioning test different abilities. No spec versions or numeric roll tolerances were supplied.
